description.summary: Advanced RAG: adds LLM query rewriting and a cross-encoder reranker on top of the Basic baseline, benchmarking local embedding models.
description.how_it_works: Indexing is the same as the baseline — one document per entity, split into character chunks and embedded. When a question comes in, an LLM first rewrites it into a search query; we retrieve chunks for both the original and rewritten query, merge them, and rerank with the BGE reranker to keep the best top-k, which the chat model then answers from.
